item.title: A study of 406 TikTok users found that 97% of them have followed a recipe they found on the app
item.description: TikTok's #FoodTok tag has become a repository filled with millions of culinary videos. Those clips range from the delectable to the downright absurd, but taken together, they are massively influential. A study conducted by a team at Poland's University of Economics in Katowice measured the magnitude of that influence.
